question: How is the mantra worshipped by Kubera structurally identified?
premises: This knowledge belongs to the referenced form.
Its vāgbhava peak functions as its śakti peak.
This form is worshipped by Kubera.
inference: The Kubera-worshipped vidyā is identified by having the vāgbhava-kūṭa serve as its śakti-kūṭa.
uncertainties: The exact referent of asya depends on the preceding context.
plain_english: For this one, the vāgbhava section itself is the śakti section; this one is worshipped by Kubera.
